text: Vinci SA's shareholder page states that at 31 December 2025 individual shareholders held 11.6% of its capital, and that more than 176,000 Group employees and former employees and about 1,000 institutional investors are shareholders.

source.name: VINCI: Becoming a shareholder
source.quote: At 31 December 2025, individual shareholders represented 11.6% of VINCI’s capital.
